title: Aston Martin Valkyrie returns to the scene of its first podium for IMSA finale at Petit Le Mans
extract: Aston Martin's Valkyrie returns to Road Atlanta for the IMSA finale, with the hypercar contesting both of the world's leading sports-car championships in 2026.

title: Even faster than Ferrari – Fernando Alonso grabs Aston Martin's best result of F1 2026
extract: Fernando Alonso took Aston Martin's best Formula 1 result of the 2026 season at Sepang, with the Adrian Newey-designed AMR26 showing its strongest pace of the year.

title: McLaren boss thinks the brand has 'untapped potential' beyond supercars
extract: McLaren's new leadership sees room to expand beyond its traditional supercar business, with substantial investment backing a broader road-car strategy.

title: Google halts open-source bug bounty program amid AI spam surge
extract: Cleartext's October 5 cybersecurity briefing reports that Google has paused its open-source bug bounty programme after a surge in AI-generated submissions overwhelmed reviewers.

title: Blackpool Play Expo 2026 showcases Vectrex gameplay and new mini console
extract: Coverage from Blackpool Play Expo highlights Vectrex hardware, the Vectrex Mini, Flea on Vectrex and an early look at the Flearun project.

title: YOUR DAILY RETRO!!! - 2026-10-05
extract: A fresh retro roundup highlights Heliobane, a new Amiga 1200 AGA shoot-'em-up, alongside a Pokémon ROM hack and an Oliver Twins feature on generative AI.

title: David Bowie celebrations mark what would have been his 80th birthday
extract: A global Bowie80 programme has launched with special events, releases, exhibitions, collaborations and fan experiences planned around what would have been David Bowie's 80th birthday in 2027.

title: OMEGA Introduces The Seamaster Diver 300m James Bond And Spectre Collection
extract: Omega has launched six Seamaster Diver 300M watches combining James Bond and Spectre designs, including two individually available steel models and two numbered collector sets.

title: News of note for readers: October 5, 2026
extract: The latest book-news roundup covers UK publishing diversity research, PEN America's latest book-ban figures, a new memoir from Tilda Swinton and other current literary developments.

title: Roddenberry Entertainment and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory join to celebrate landmark anniversaries
extract: Roddenberry Entertainment and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory are collaborating on a new interview series celebrating the 60th anniversary of Star Trek and JPL's 90th anniversary.
